stem: A square garden has sides of \((3x - 2)\) meters. A rectangular flower bed with an area of \(5x\) square meters is added beside it. The total area, in square meters, of the garden and the flower bed is \(ax^{2} + bx + c\), where \(a\), \(b\), and \(c\) are constants. What is the value of \(a + b + c\)?
solution: Add the flower bed: \(9x^{2} - 7x + 4\), so \(a + b + c = 9 - 7 + 4 = 6\).
Shortcut: \(a + b + c\) is the total area at \(x = 1\), which is \(1^{2} + 5 = 6\).
verify:
x = symbols('x')
p = Poly(expand((3*x - 2)**2 + 5*x), x)
assert p.all_coeffs() == [9, -7, 4]
assert [Rational(v) for v in spr_answers] == [sum(p.all_coeffs())]
